title: Animal Community Cat Spay/Neuter Services
description: Requests for services related to community cats, including spay/neuter surgery and vaccinations. This request type should be used when a resident is seeking veterinary services for community cats rather than reporting a nuisance or complaint.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for community cat veterinary services.
actions.why: Request spay/neuter surgery or vaccinations for community cats when a resident is seeking veterinary services.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Animal Community Cat Spay/Neuter Services" requests is not for reporting a community cat nuisance or complaint.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Animal Care and Control" > Choose "Animal Community Cat Spay/Neuter Services"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Animal Care and Control" > Choose "Animal Community Cat Spay/Neuter Services"
